# dsh-caption-bar
English | 中文
**Reclaim a full row of vertical space in DeepSeek Harness.** Instead of spending a separate row on
conversation navigation and session utilities, this desktop layout plugin seats the view tabs in the
Windows caption row and compresses the remaining utilities into a 42px right rail. More of the wind
ow is left for the conversation—especially valuable on laptops and other short displays.
It:
- places **对话 / 轨迹 / 上下文 / 编队** on the Windows caption row, immediately after the native **应用 / 编辑 /

⋯** menu, with matching spacing and hover treatment;
- centres the current session title in the roo

m left between those tabs and the native window controls;
- keeps fullscreen immediately left of min

imise / maximise / close;
- stacks the remaining header utilities in a compact 42px rail at the righ

t edge;
- shows background-job and subagent status changes in a fixed bubble that never changes rail
- shows background-job and subagent status changes in a fixed bubble that never changes rail width.
Verified with Codex UI 1.1.49 and DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.3+.
## Final layout
| Area | Contents |
| Caption row | application menu → view tabs / more-views → centred session title → fullscreen → nat

ive window buttons |
| Right rail | agent preset, subagent status/count/menu, background-job status/

count/menu, file-manager split control, utilities menu, right-sidebar control |
| Conversation | giv
es up exactly `--dsh-capbar-rail` on the right, so the rail never covers messages |
The tab row uses the preload menu's own dimensions and tokens: 28px controls, 10px horizontal paddin
g, 6px radius, 2px gaps, 14px text, and `--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover` on hover. Codex UI's acti
ve-tab slider remains the selection indicator.
## Compact rail
Compact mode is on by default:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Control | Compact representation |

| Agent preset | existing preset icon; full description remains in `title` |
| Subagent | existing s

tate dot + extracted count + existing chevron |
| Background jobs | existing state dot + extracted c

ount + existing chevron |
| File manager | existing primary button above its existing menu chevron |
| Utilities / right sidebar | unchanged icon controls |
The compact rail is **42px** wide with 30px controls (6px on each side). Set this on `body` to resto
re complete labels and the 104px rail; the layout sweep notices within two seconds:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
All compact markers, replacement counts and titles added by this plugin are removed when compact mod
e is disabled or the plugin is unloaded.
## Status bubble
Background jobs and subagents publish dynamic status without participating in rail layout:

- the latest change appears for three seconds in one fixed bubble to the rail's left;
- a newer stat
ly app background, border, radius and text tokens—no custom colour, shadow, blur or animation.
The plugin reads semantic DOM projections (`aria-label`, status dots and stable data attributes), no
t private jobs-store APIs.
## Visual contract
The plugin is layout-focused. It does not add custom colours, fonts, icons, blur, opacity, shadows o
r animations. Its deliberate visual exceptions are narrowly tested:

1. remove the stock header's `border-bottom` hairline;
2. mirror the preload menubar's existing butt

on dimensions, radius, label colours and hover token for the view tabs;
3. hide selected labels in c

ompact mode while preserving existing iconography and dynamic counts;
4. style the transient status
bubble exclusively with existing app tokens.
It never sets `order` or `display: contents`, and it does not replace app controls with custom repli
ever sets `order` or `display: contents`, and it does not replace app controls with custom replicas.
## Compatibility notes
The plugin intentionally coordinates with Codex UI:

- sets `body[data-dsh-title-bar-compat]` and `--dsh-title-bar-strip`;
- preserves `[data-dcu-tab-sli

der]` by keeping the tab list as its positioned containing block;
- relies on semantic selectors whe
re available (`role`, `aria-*`, `data-open-target="directory"`), with CSS-module class stems only fo

r stable header layout seats;
- excludes `[role="menu"]` trees from rail text rules and from the lay

eader layout seats;
- excludes `[role="menu"]` trees from rail text rules and from the layout sweep.
Hosts without Codex UI receive a minimal one-column fallback.

## Develop
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`src/client/index.tsx` contains the stylesheet, applier, title fallback, fullscreen button, compact-
mode projection and status bubble. `lib/` is committed because the host serves it directly.
The build refuses to run if a backtick appears inside the `SHEET` template literal, which turns an o
therwise distant SWC syntax error into a precise message.
Diagnostics are compiled but silent by default; set `DEBUG = true` in the client source while invest
igating layout state.
## Lifecycle
`apply()` returns its disposer to Cordis. Unloading the plugin retracts:

- injected stylesheet, body class and Codex UI compatibility marker;
- title fallback and status bub
ine layout overrides, restored to the values they displaced.
The smoke suite drives the real disposer and asserts this contract.
## Tuning

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---:|---|
| `--dsh-capbar-compact` | `1` | `1`: compact 42px r

ail; `0`: full-label 104px rail |
| `--dsh-capbar-compact-box` | `30px` | compact control target |
|

`--dsh-capbar-rail` | `104px` | full-label width; compact mode overrides it to 42px |
| `--dsh-capb

ar-rail-gap` | `6px` | vertical gap between rail items |
| `--dsh-capbar-button` | `28px` | fullscre

en button box |
| `--dsh-capbar-gap` | `10px` | gap before native caption buttons |
